src/**.instructions: Core library consumed by services/Core and services/zatca-einvoicing. Focus on: (1) backward-compatible public API (GenerateQrCode, GenerateCSR, InvoiceSign, Certificate, Tag subtypes); (2) correct ZATCA TLV encoding and C14N hashing; (3) OpenSSL EC key operations; (4) input validation (UID format, country code length, invoice type bitmask). Any change to tag numbering or QR encoding format will silently break ZATCA compliance.

src/Tags/**.instructions: Each Tag subclass defines a fixed ZATCA TLV tag number. Tag numbers must never change — they are part of the ZATCA QR spec. Verify getValue() returns raw bytes (not base64 re-encoded). Tag 9 (CertificateSignature) is only added for simplified invoices.

src/Helpers/**.instructions: UXML.toTagsArray() and InvoiceSign.sign() implement the ZATCA Phase 2 signing flow. Any mutation to C14N computation, UBL node removal order, or signature construction will produce invoices that fail ZATCA validation. Test against tests/simplified_invoice.xml.

tests/**.instructions: Tests — flag only critical logic errors or incorrect test fixture usage.

rules.rule: No hardcoded secrets — private keys, certificates, and ZATCA API credentials must come from env vars or Doppler, never from source files.

Public API backward compatibility is mandatory: GenerateQrCode::fromArray(), GenerateCSR::fromRequest(), InvoiceSign::sign(), and all Tag constructors are consumed by services/Core and services/zatca-einvoicing. Changing method signatures or return types is a breaking change.

All CSRRequest setters must validate inputs and throw CSRValidationException (not generic exceptions) for ZATCA-specific format violations (UID 15-digit rule, country code 2-char rule, OrgUnit 10-digit rule for group taxpayers).
The currentEnv field on CSRRequest controls which OID is embedded in the OpenSSL config. Ensure any new environment values map to the correct ZATCA OID string.

other.context: salla/zatca is a PHP library (no Laravel, no artisan) implementing the Saudi ZATCA e-invoicing standard. It is consumed by services/Core and services/zatca-einvoicing. The library covers Phase 1 (TLV QR from a Tag array) and Phase 2 (EC CSR generation + UBL XML invoice signing). Changes to public entrypoints ripple to both consumer repos.
